description: Protobuf wire decoder (schemaless) — Decode raw Protocol Buffers bytes without a .proto: data= hex (spaces/0x ok) or base64/base64url (format= to force). Returns every field with number, wire type and byte offset; varints as uint, int64 (two's complement) and zigzag sint; fixed32/fixed64 as integer and float/double; length-delimited fields classified as UTF-8 string, nested message (recursive, max_depth= default 12, max 32) or bytes with hex/base64 plus packed varint/float/double readings; legacy groups supported. Also a compact json view keyed by field number (repeated fields become arrays). grpc=true strips a 5-byte gRPC frame prefix. Invalid wire data returns 422 with the failing offset. Max 200,000 bytes. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_protobuf_decode
